rows.ARS:
Orange blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Allanson Rose
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2015).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses as 'Allanson Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Vermilion. Medium bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Ludwigs Roses says the Allansons, who are keen gardeners, were presented with this rose by their family. The blooms are bright vermilion which intensifies to burnt orange as the open blooms are exposed to the sun...
